parameters.content:
## 2. Content Evaluation & Relevancy Checks

To ensure Tayana Academy only engages with high-quality, professional, and relevant content, every today's post undergoes dual-stage validation:

- **Text Relevancy Node**: Analyzes post captions against core focus areas (AI, Tech, STEM, Employability, L&D, Digital Skills) and excludes personal/lifestyle/entertainment/cryptocurrency topics.
- **Visual Relevancy Node**: Runs OCR and visual classification on the preview image URL to ensure there is educational context or a related visual subject.
- **Merge & Filter**: Combines both analyses. Engagement only proceeds if the final relevance score is **>= 70** and `engage = true`.

## AI SOCIAL ENGAGEMENT AGENT

Automated Instagram Content Monitoring, Relevancy Evaluation, Comment Drafting & Human-Approved Publishing.

WORKFLOW OBJECTIVE
Automatically identify relevant Instagram posts and prepare meaningful engagement while maintaining human approval before publishing.

MAIN PROCESS

1. Get Instagram influencer data
2. Process influencers one by one
3. Fetch the latest Instagram post
4. Validate post eligibility
5. Analyze text and image relevance using AI
6. Calculate final engagement eligibility
7. Generate a professional comment
8. Check for duplicate engagement
9. Keep comment in Pending state for review
10. Like and publish the approved comment
11. Update the influencer record in the database

IMPORTANT
• AI performs analysis and comment generation.
• Duplicate checks prevent repeated engagement.
• Human approval is required before public engagement.
• Database records are updated after successful processing.

## 3. Comment Drafting & Duplicate Prevention

Once a post is qualified, the system prepares the draft:

- **Cohere Chat Agent**: Generates a context-aware, value-added comment (15–30 words) that sounds natural, professional, and is strictly non-promotional (no links, sales pitches, or hashtags).
- **Duplicate Verification**: Checks the sheet database using the unique `post_id` to ensure we do not draft duplicate comments for the same post.
- **Database Append**: Saves the post and draft comment to the `Post like & comment` sheet with the status `Pending` for human review.

## 4. Publishing Flow (Human-Approved)

This independent sequence publishes approved content:

- **Fetch Approved**: Queries the `Post like & comment` sheet for entries where `approval_status = Approved`.
- **Unipile HTTP Post**: Sends the approved comment text and publishes a "Like" reaction under the post.
- **Publish Status Update**: Changes the sheet status from `Approved` to `Published` to ensure the post is not processed again on the next run.

parameters.content:
## 1. WORKFLOW OVERVIEW & ARCHITECTURE

PURPOSE
Collect Instagram influencer data and identify the latest post that can be evaluated for engagement.

FLOW

Schedule Trigger
↓
Get Influencer Data
↓
Loop Over Items
↓
Fetch Influencer Post
↓
Format Post
↓
Post Eligibility Check

## CODE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Schedule Trigger
• Starts the workflow automatically according to the configured schedule.

2. Get Influencer Data
• Retrieves Instagram influencer records from the database.
• Provides the profile/username/account information required for API calls.

3. Loop Over Items
• Processes one influencer at a time.
• Ensures each influencer is handled independently.
• Skipped/processed influencers return to the loop.

4. Fetch_Influencer_Post
• Uses the Instagram/Unipile integration to retrieve recent posts.
• Retrieves the post information required for analysis.

5. formatPost
• Normalizes the API response into a standard structure.
• Prepares fields such as:
  - post_id
  - post_url
  - caption
  - post date
  - influencer/profile information
  - engagement information

6. hasTodayPost
• Performs the first eligibility check.
• Verifies that a usable and recent post exists.
• Prevents processing of already-commented/ineligible posts.

OUTPUT
Only eligible posts continue to AI content evaluation.

2. CONTENT EVALUATION & RELEVANCY CHECKS

PURPOSE
Determine whether the Instagram post is relevant and appropriate for professional engagement.

The workflow performs TWO AI evaluations:

A. TEXT RELEVANCY
B. IMAGE RELEVANCY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
A. TEXT RELEVANCY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Node: checkPostRelevancyText

AI evaluates:
• Caption/content
• Topic
• Category
• Sentiment
• Language
• Professional relevance
• Educational relevance

PREFERRED TOPICS

✓ AI & Technology
✓ Education
✓ Career Development
✓ Leadership
✓ Employability
✓ Upskilling / Reskilling
✓ Future of Work
✓ Programming
✓ Data Science
✓ Digital Skills
✓ Business / Entrepreneurship
✓ Professional Development

GENERALLY EXCLUDED

✗ Personal content
✗ Entertainment
✗ Food / Travel
✗ Fashion / Lifestyle
✗ Politics / Religion
✗ Sports / Gaming
✗ Celebrity / Music / Movies
✗ Relationships
✗ Irrelevant promotional content

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
B. IMAGE RELEVANCY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Node: GetImage
• Retrieves the post image.

Node: CheckImageRelevancy
• Uses AI vision analysis.
• Determines whether the image supports the post's professional/relevant context.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
C. MERGE RESULTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Node: Merge
• Combines text and image analysis results.

Node: format_Relevancy
• Converts AI output into structured fields.

Node: check_relevancy
• Makes the final engagement decision.

POST CONTINUES ONLY IF:

✓ Content is relevant
✓ AI recommends engagement
✓ Relevance score meets the configured threshold
✓ Language/content is eligible

IF NOT ELIGIBLE
→ Skip post
→ Return to Loop Over Items

IF ELIGIBLE
→ Generate comment
